---
title: "Getting Started"
---

## Prerequisites

- Python 3.10+
- OpenCL runtime/driver available on the host
- Quarto (for documentation rendering)

## Install

### Option A: uv

```bash
uv venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .
```

### Option B: pixi

```bash
pixi install
```

## Run SMACCL

Main processing module:

```bash
python -m smaccl.c3s_smaccl <config_file>
```

Examples:

```bash
python -m smaccl.c3s_smaccl c3s_config.cfg
python -m smaccl.c3s_smaccl c3s_probav_config.cfg
python -m smaccl.c3s_smaccl viirs_config.cfg
```

## Run Tests

```bash
pytest tests/
```

or

```bash
pixi run tests
```

## Render Documentation

```bash
quarto render docs
quarto preview docs
```
